# ForgeSuite Studio

> Zero-backend, privacy-first micro-SaaS, creator media, DevSecOps, and Web3 security tool portfolio by youthmy11-ai. Offers 11 client-side browser applications (including MediaBrief Studio AI voiceover script duration calculator, rights/consent pre-flight scanner & multi-aspect spec builder, ClipCaption Lab 9:16 subtitle auditor/time-shifter/converter, WalletLens 6-chain EVM & Solana portfolio/EIP-7702/Safe inspector, TokenGuard live EVM & Solana contract risk scanner, and BrandGuard 8-TLD domain & developer handle checker), 2 open-core desktop/browser tools (AutoShorts Studio and WebLead & Table Extractor), a zero-dependency Node 20+ MCP Server (v1.5.0, 10 tools — 1-command run: `npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`), 8 autonomous 24/7 A2A + x402 cloud agents ($440 USDC active marketplace bids), and an All-Access Lifetime Pro Bundle ($15–$49 pricing, zero subscriptions, zero server uploads) with instant client-side on-chain BSC USDT (BEP20) and Solana SPL USDC auto-unlock plus TRC20, Binance Pay, and PayPal checkout.

ForgeSuite Studio is designed for solo founders, independent freelancers, AI engineers, content creators, and Web3 builders who want fast local-first software without recurring subscriptions or cloud tracking.

- **Client-Side Privacy Guarantee**: All 11 web applications run 100% in local browser memory with zero ForgeSuite backend servers, zero analytics, and zero data uploads. QR codes are rendered offline via pure ES module JavaScript (`assets/qr.js`), CryptoBill invoices share state via client-only `#inv=` URL fragments, MediaBrief Studio calculates voiceover pacing & compliance specs locally, ClipCaption Lab audits and converts `.srt`/`.vtt`/`.txt`/`.ass` tracks offline, BrandGuard queries Google DoH + CORS RDAP directly, and TokenGuard / WalletLens query CORS-friendly public JSON-RPC nodes directly from the browser.
- **Transparent Lifetime Pricing**: 11 web applications provide generous free tiers immediately; Pro lifetime licenses are $15 (CryptoBill Forge Pro — also unlocks MediaBrief Studio 25-Asset Campaign Batch Matrix, ClipCaption Lab Pro animated `.ass` + 25-file batch, BrandGuard 25-Brand Agency Matrix & WalletLens 25-Wallet Treasury Watchlist), $19 (AutoShorts Studio Pro — also unlocks MediaBrief Studio Pro & ClipCaption Lab Pro), $15 (WebLead & Table Extractor Pro), or $35 for the All-Access Bundle (compare at $49, save $14 — unlocks every Pro tool plus MediaBrief 25-Asset Campaign Matrix, TokenGuard 25-token Batch Watchlist, BrandGuard 25-Brand Matrix, WalletLens 25-Wallet Watchlist & ClipCaption Lab 25-file Batch Studio).
- **Instant Crypto & PayPal Checkout**: Automatic client-side RPC verification on BNB Smart Chain (`USDT BEP20`) and Solana Mainnet (`SPL USDC`) issues deterministic checksummed offline license keys (`FS-PRO-...`) in seconds. Manual rails (`USDT TRC20`, `Binance Pay`, `PayPal`) are supported via `youthmy11@gmail.com`.

## Live Browser Applications (100% Client-Side)

- [ForgeSuite Studio Hub & Storefront](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/): Catalog of all 15 tools and bundle offerings, 8 autonomous 24/7 NEAR AI cloud agents, interactive CryptoBill QR sandbox, transparent pricing table, and instant on-chain license verifier.
- [CryptoBill Forge](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/cryptobill.html): Free + $15 Pro lifetime serverless crypto & PayPal freelance invoice builder with A4 PDF export, deterministic offline QR codes, and shareable `#inv=` client payment links.
- [MediaBrief Studio — AI Voiceover Script Duration Calculator, Rights Pre-Flight & Multi-Aspect Spec Builder](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mediastudio.html): Free 100% client-side Latin & CJK word/syllable duration calculator (`135 / 150 / 165 WPM` vs target seconds, `FFmpeg atempo` `0.85x–1.20x` distortion guard, `±0.5s` golden window word trim/add guidance), celebrity/politician likeness & Disney/Marvel/Nintendo copyright pre-flight scanner (`0–100` Safety Score), `1:1` (`1024x1024`), `9:16` (`1080x1920`), `16:9` (`1920x1080`) & `4:5` (`1080x1350`) safe-zone spec builder, and Pro 25-Asset Campaign Batch Matrix (`$15` Pro / `$19` AutoShorts Pro / `$35` Bundle) with 1-click JSON handoffs to `@pay-per-use-media-gen` (`$0.45 USDC`), `@short-video-clipper` (`$0.50 USDC`) & `@multi-lang-video-dubber` (`$0.65 USDC`).
- [AI Voiceover Script Duration Calculator & Media Compliance Checker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/ai-voiceover-script-duration-calculator-compliance-checker.html): Specialized creator & performance marketing playbook covering `135 / 150 / 165 WPM` word budgets for `8s`, `15s`, `30s` & `60s` ad slots, multilingual CJK syllable timing, WSOLA `FFmpeg atempo` distortion boundaries, likeness consent (`consent=0` vs `consent=1`) & trademark screening, 1-click `mediastudio.html` presets, and `media_brief_audit` MCP v1.5.0 snippets.
- [ClipCaption Lab — 9:16 Subtitle Auditor, Time-Shifter & Converter](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/srtlab.html): Free bidirectional `.srt` <-> `.vtt` <-> `.txt` subtitle converter, `+/- ms` time-shifter, tempo scaler, overlap & `CPS > 20` reading-speed detector, 9:16 TikTok/Reels/Shorts safe-zone previewer, mid-sentence cut detector, and Pro `1080x1920` animated `.ass` exporter + 25-file batch studio (`$15` Pro / `$19` AutoShorts Pro / `$35` Bundle) with 1-click handoff to `@pay-per-use-media-gen` (`$0.45 USDC`), `@short-video-clipper` (`$0.50 USDC`) & `@multi-lang-video-dubber` (`$0.65 USDC`).
- [TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts 9:16 Subtitle Safe-Zone Checker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tiktok-reels-9-16-subtitle-safe-zone-checker.html): Specialized `1080x1920` vertical subtitle geometry & reading-speed checker mapping TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts top/right/bottom UI danger zones, enforcing `CPS <= 20` and `<= 32` chars/line, eliminating `.srt`/`.vtt` timestamp overlaps, and exporting FFmpeg-ready animated `.ass` tracks with 1-click `srtlab.html` presets and `subtitle_caption_audit` MCP v1.5.0 snippets.
- [YouTube Most Replayed Clipper & 26-Language AI Video Dubbing Guide](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/youtube-most-replayed-clipper-ai-dubbing-guide.html): Technical creator media pipeline guide explaining non-overlapping YouTube `Most Replayed` retention peak extraction with sentence-onset/silence snapping, 26-language F0 multi-speaker neural dubbing with stereo `Mid/Side` background music & SFX preservation, verbatim `Do-Not-Translate` brand locks, AutoShorts Studio Pro (`$19`), and `@pay-per-use-media-gen` (`$0.45 USDC`), `@short-video-clipper` (`$0.50 USDC`) & `@multi-lang-video-dubber` (`$0.65 USDC`) cloud deliverables.
- [TokenGuard Risk Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokenaudit.html): Free unlimited single-token scanner + Pro 25-token Batch Watchlist (`$35` Bundle) auditing live EVM (`Base`, `Ethereum`, `BSC`, `Arbitrum`) bytecode opcodes (`SELFDESTRUCT`, `DELEGATECALL`), EIP-1967/1167 proxies, honeypot tax selectors, and Solana (`SPL` & `Token-2022`) `mintAuthority`, `freezeAuthority`, `permanentDelegate`, `transferFeeConfig`, and holder concentration (supports direct query deep-links `?chain=solana&mint=...` and `?chain=base&address=...`).
- [Solana Token-2022 Risk & Permanent Delegate Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/solana-token-2022-scanner.html): Specialized Solana `TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb` extension & authority scanner explaining `PermanentDelegate` seizure backdoors, `TransferFeeConfig` 100% fee traps, `TransferHook` CPI honeypots, `FreezeAuthority`, and Top-10 holder concentration with 1-click live mainnet deep-links and `solana_mint_risk_scan` MCP snippets.
- [EVM EIP-1967 Proxy, SELFDESTRUCT & Honeypot Bytecode Scanner](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/evm-proxy-honeypot-scanner.html): Specialized EVM bytecode disassembler & storage-slot inspector across Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum explaining unverified `DELEGATECALL` proxy traps, EIP-1167 minimal clones, PUSH-aware `SELFDESTRUCT` disassembly, and mutable sell-tax/blacklist selectors with 1-click deep-links and `evm_token_risk_scan` MCP snippets.

- [USPTO Trademark, 8-TLD Domain & Developer Brand Checker](https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/uspto-trademark-domain-brand-checker.html): Specialized AI/SaaS startup brand collision scanner & technical guide covering 8 domain TLDs (`.com`, `.ai`, `.io`, `.dev`, `.app`, `.org`, `.net`, `.xyz`), `npm`/`PyPI`/`GitHub` package registries, Apple App Store / Google Play title screening, and federal USPTO Class 009/042 trademark checks with 1-click `brandcheck.html?brand=...` deep-links, `brand_domain_handle_scan` MCP snippets, and `@forge-brand-checker` (`$0.35 USDC`) A2A handoff.
